name: check-panic-expression-operator-test-baa47123b9/checkpanic-generic-multi-union-p
reason: The checking-expr production covers checkpanic. This case calls a function returning int|boolean|error, receives error("Generic Error"), and must panic when checkpanic consumes that error. test_design_notes: The @panic marker is placed at error construction; the actual panic occurs when the caller evaluates checkpanic. The test asserts an uncaught panic, with no @args or @output directives.
